rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward and Lava supply supported arts damage during overlapping eastern exposures. Require artillery destruction before it exits the useful battery coverage; retain both medics throughout.
GALLUS clears #3 and Castle clears #1 by their withdrawal deadlines. Melantha and then Beagle intercept upper outer hostiles. Confirm the civilian safely reaches its objective.
Fang hands upper central interception to Spot. Both medics sustain the lane; both casters can attack enemies held at [3,5].
Vanilla uses supported attack enhancement during opening survival and hands lower central interception to Noir Corne. Both medics and both casters cover [4,5].
Melantha handles the opening pair at [1,5]. Beagle later blocks at [1,3], using defense skills and basic attacks. Its sustained survival is required despite absent baseline medic coverage.
Plume handles the opening pair at [6,5]. Midnight later holds that tile, using arts windows and Ansel's supported extended-range healing.

Midnight clears #4 before officer pressure can trap the civilian near it. Durin clears #2 before withdrawal. Midnight holds officers upstream while the civilian traverses the western section; require safe arrival.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception and automatic DP.
Opening lower central interception, attack enhancement and DP.
Opening upper outer duels; exclude both roadblocks from attack range.
Opening lower outer duels; exclude both roadblocks from attack range.
Opening global heal and central healing bridge.
Permanent central and battery healing; supported skill extends coverage to Midnight.
Dedicated western upper roadblock #1 clearance; no talent credit.
Permanent central and battery healing, including Ansel.
Upper eastern artillery exposures and both central interception tiles.
Eastern lower roadblock #4 clearance followed by permanent lower outer interception.
Lower eastern artillery exposure and both central interception tiles; single-target credit only.
Replace Fang with upper central three-block defense; no healing-skill credit.
Replace Vanilla with lower central three-block defense.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward and Lava accumulate damage across their actual rotated ranges. No chosen target, splash damage, forced artillery lock or immunity is assumed.
formation_structure.final: Beagle holds upper outer, Spot upper central, Noir Corne lower central and Midnight lower outer. Both medics and both casters remain deployed.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla hold central lanes. Melantha and Plume face west at column 5, keeping eastern devices outside their attack ranges. Lancet bridges central survival.
formation_structure.protection: GALLUS and Castle clear the upper restraints independently. Midnight clears the lower eastern restraint upstream of the civilian; Durin clears the lower western restraint.
formation_structure.sustain: Ansel [2,5] UP and Hibiscus [5,5] DOWN cover each other, both central blockers, Steward and Lava within baseline ranges. Ansel's supported extension supplies intermittent lower outer healing.

formation_transitions.transition: Ansel joins Lancet before the bridge is withdrawn.
Retire Lancet; Ansel temporarily carries central healing.
Establish permanent dual healing; retire Melantha after her two opening kills.
Retire Plume after her two opening kills and before prolonged lower eastern artillery exposure.
Begin the permanent upper arts battery.
Midnight takes lower eastern clearance and later outer interception.
Release both upper clearance slots after their fixed clearance deadlines.
Release Durin's clearance slot after the lower western deadline.
Beagle closes upper outer interception before the paired officers reach its western tile.
Replace Fang with Spot on the same central tile in listed action order.
Replace Vanilla with Noir Corne on the same central tile in listed action order.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four hostile interception lanes. Vanilla must survive until its first skill; Lancet then supplies deployment healing and central recovery.
Preserve both vanguards, finish opening outer duels, start dedicated upper clearance and establish permanent healing.
Complete both opening outer kills before fixed retreats. Start Steward and Midnight, then finish both upper restraints before releasing their clearers.
Clear both lower restraints, complete Lava's battery slot and establish Beagle before upper paired officers reach its tile.
Use Midnight's first arts window, retain both medics and replace central vanguards with three-block defenders.
Finish artillery within useful battery coverage, clear central armor with both casters and preserve all four interception lanes through the final rush.

Keep the final formation attacking, blocking and healing until spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, both civilians have safely arrived, remaining life is positive and both leaks and protected deaths are zero.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic +6 DP grants at modeled seconds 19, 44, 69, 94 and 119 require uninterrupted survival. No later grant is budgeted.
Supported attack enhancement and +6 DP. The first activation precedes Plume's deployment; later grants require survival through the listed actions.
Strengthen shared healing and extend coverage to Midnight. Baseline cross-healing does not depend on the extension.
Strengthen shared healing during upper artillery exposure and subsequent pressure.
Supported arts conversion for lower outer officer clearance; no critical-hit credit.
Use supported deployment SP and attack-speed enhancement for artillery and central cleanup; no splash credit.
Reduce upper outer attrition and residual artillery risk.
Automatic enhanced attacks only; no highest-defense priority or player-selected target.
Basic three-block defense and ordinary attacks only.

previous_plan_to_revise.tactical_thesis: Fund earlier sustained healing through Vanilla's supported attack-and-DP skill. Separate opening outer interception from device clearance, retain both medics throughout combat, and place the eastern arts battery where it can subsequently attack blocked central armor. All survival, clearance and artillery-damage deadlines remain unverified tactical hypotheses.

causal_interpretation.chain: Deaths of Hibiscus, Steward, Lava, Ansel, Spot, Noir Corne and Beagle removed intended healing, arts output and corridor blocking; later skill commands then had no live source.
causal_interpretation.direct_failure: The opening survived long enough to verify Fang's declared kill, but later operator deaths left multiple routes uncovered, producing 13 leaks.
causal_interpretation.protected_target_failure: #3 was killed by artillery after officer damage; #14 was not observed reaching its objective.
causal_interpretation.unknown: Exact client target priority, continuous-frame timing, client-faithful AoE targeting, and whether a different structure can preserve all duties remain UNKNOWN.

hypothesis_evaluation.interpretation: The declared first observable occurred. This verifies only that one declared event, not the full tactical hypothesis, perfect objective, targeting fidelity, robustness or real-game behavior.
